name: @quarto-wizard/schema

scripts.test:lua: quarto pandoc lua -e "assert(loadfile('src/validation/schema.lua'))" && quarto pandoc lua tests/validation/lua/run.lua && quarto pandoc lua tests/validation/lua/conformance.lua --findings ../../node_modules/.cache/quarto-wizard-schema/lua-field-findings.json ../../docs/_extensions ../../test-fixtures/_extensions && quarto pandoc lua tests/validation/lua/tonumber.lua tests/validation/lua/tonumber-corpus.json ../../node_modules/.cache/quarto-wizard-schema/lua-tonumber.json && QW_SCHEMA_CONFORMANCE=1 vitest run tests/validation/field-value-conformance.test.ts tests/validation/tonumber-conformance.test.ts
